STATEMENT O
WISCONSIN'S ENVIRONMENTAL DECADE
1. The Jurisdictional Highway System Plan for Milwaukee County, adopted in 1970, includes the Airport Spur and is a refinement of Southeastern Wisconsin Regional Planning Commission's initial Regional Surface Transportation Plan. SEWRPC is presently updating the land use map, which will show the Airport Spur.
2. This sentence has been deleted in the Final E.I.S.
3. This statement has been deleted. Federal emission limits originally set for 1975 and now postponed until 1976 apply only to 1976 and later model year cars. However, as the number of new automobiles equipped with emission control devices replace the older vehicles, carbon monoxide emission will decrease significantly from current levels.
4. The state of the art for obtaining emission factors has been updated using Environmental Protection Agency Publication AP-42, "Computation of Air Pollution Emission Factors," dated August 1973. The 1990 emission factors are now adjusted for speed.
5. The Airport Spur is in conformance and will implement national, regional, state, and local transportation goals. The proposed freeway would accommodate longer trips and high speed traffic demands of auto, truck, and modified rapid transit vehicles and remove this portion of the total ground transportation demand from adjacent local streets. The proposed facility will also provide an opportunity for improved modified rapid bus transit to the area as an alternate to continued automobile use. Please see pages 80 and 81.
6. The increase in traffic volumes will result because of the increase in air passenger traffic to Mitchell Field and not just because the Airport Spur is constructed.
7. A macroscale analysis, measured in tons per day, has been done, which compares the total study area pollutant burden between the build and no build alternatives. A microscale analysis or sensative receptor analysis was made for the development adjacent to the Airport Spur and was measured in parts per million (ppm).
8. Please see page 150 for a response.
